name: Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from any edge of the window, with a bottom sheet you can drag down to dismiss.

props.name: children
props.description: A button that opens the drawer, then the Drawer.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Open state (controlled). Use defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the drawer opens or closes.

props.name: side
props.description: The edge it slides in from. Side panels are 380 pixels wide and full height; bottom is a sheet with a grab handle that can be dragged down to dismiss.

props.name: isDismissable
props.description: Close when the scrim is clicked. Escape always closes unless isKeyboardDismissDisabled is set.

props.name: backdropBlur
props.description: Blurs the page behind the scrim. Off by default: the browser redraws the blur on every frame while anything behind it changes, which stalls on large pages, most of all in Firefox.

props.name: closeButton
props.description: Shows a close button in the top corner.

props.name: children
props.description: DrawerHeader, DrawerBody and DrawerFooter. A function receives close(). Any button with slot="close" also closes.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Open state, when used without a DrawerTrigger.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the open state changes, when used without a DrawerTrigger.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Labels the drawer when it has no DrawerTitle.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Classes for the full-window layer that holds the scrim and the panel.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Stays put while the body scrolls; on a bottom sheet it is also a place to grab.

props.name: children
props.description: The drawer's name. Labels the dialog.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Scrolls between the header and footer, with a hairline on the side that has more to see.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. Actions aligned to the end; put the main action last.
